name: Irving Mall
summary: Long-standing, bi-level indoor shopping center with department stores, a cinema & a food court.
demographics: Irving Mall attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic reflective of the Dallas-Fort Worth suburban market, with a strong representation of young families, Hispanic households, and working professionals aged 25-54. The primary trade area includes Irving residents and nearby communities along the I-635 corridor, with median household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $75,000. Shoppers typically seek value-oriented fashion, family dining options, and convenient one-stop shopping experiences that cater to everyday needs and occasional purchases.
description: Irving Mall, located at 3880 West Irving Mall in Irving, Texas, has served as a prominent shopping destination for the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area. As a traditional enclosed regional shopping center, the mall was designed to provide a comprehensive retail experience with multiple anchor stores and a diverse mix of national retailers. Over the years, Irving Mall has been a gathering place for families and shoppers seeking convenient access to fashion, dining, and entertainment options under one roof. The center's strategic location in Irving, positioned between Dallas and Fort Worth along major transportation corridors, has made it accessible to a broad customer base from surrounding communities. While the website is currently parked for sale, Irving Mall has been recognized as part of the competitive North Texas retail landscape that serves the region's growing population.
